_notes: A ruling on a split-shaped price move no data row explains (kind suspicion; record id suspected_split_<SYMBOL>_<date>).
Required: ideaId, kind 'suspicion', recordId (from status), decision.
decision 'price_move': the move was real; nothing is split. Leave ratio out.
decision 'split' needs ratio: the share multiplier (2 for a 2-for-1, 0.1 for a 1-for-10), which must match the move the record stands for.
No payload or actionId for this kind.
